Horoscope predictions and equinox discussion for September 22-23, 2026

On 22 September 2026, Hindustan published a Pandit-led horoscope segment asking how the day would be for readers. On 23 September 2026, Aaj Tak released a daily horoscope covering all zodiac signs, advising people to avoid sudden decisions, high-speed driving, to watch their health and to refrain from investing money in business. Zee News on the same date reported on the upcoming September 23 equinox, questioning whether the day and night will each last exactly twelve hours.
